prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production raster component extraction/reconstruction for Godot. Input1 is the EXACT APPROVED B Mastery Ribbon screenshot. Reproduce ITS ART, not a new style or new King identity. Return a wide transparent-background asset board, EXACTLY3 columns by2 rows of equal cells with generous gutters. NO words, numbers, captions or backdrop. Every component complete and isolated in its cell, in the screenshot's engraved black-steel/silver/cyan/violet RPG style. Top LEFT: extract/reproduce the SAME ROUND King portrait from input: his spiky dark-brown hair, small warm face, red scarf, pixel clusters and exact confident expression, within the exact circular silver frame/cyan gems. No attached level tag and no shoulders extending outside the circle. Do not make him a smooth anime teenager or change his face. Top MIDDLE: the empty attached LEVEL PLAQUE from directly below his face, about2.6:1 wide, black navy center, ornate chamfered silver border and tiny cyan side diamonds, no Lv10 text. Top RIGHT: the COIN PLAQUE under portrait, about3.3:1 wide, same chamfered black/silver shape and fine cold corners, include the little round gold coin at the LEFT only, leaving the rest blank. Bottom LEFT: the EXACT PURPLE MASTERY RIBBON CHASSIS, about5:1 wide, as ONE integrated frame with header and lower gauge area. Black navy header contains an EMPTY small angular silver emblem plate left and EMPTY small angular silver RANK PLATE right; central header is blank. Lower half contains the long inset gauge well with complete stepped/chamfered silver edges and subtle violet edging, dark empty center, NO fill, no text. Preserve the outer purple corner diamonds and strong dark outlines. Bottom MIDDLE: the screenshot's ornate HOVER CARD frame, about1.8:1 wide: clipped/chamfered corners, black-steel slim silver border, tiny cold cyan corner rivets, dark navy clean EMPTY interior, with no content or separator because those are native layers. Bottom RIGHT: a separate EMPTY long mastery GAUGE WELL about12:1 wide, black/navy center with beveled silver chamfered ends and fine violet lower edge, no fill/text. All six parts must retain screenshot proportions/silhouettes/materials, no extra plates or concept redesign, no gold UI rims. High detail source pixels for3x-density exports; keep strong illustrated/pixel RPG outlines without noisy microdetail. Genuine transparency outside all parts.

Same black-steel/cold-blue/violet/ivory illustration with strong navy defining contours; not vector art, not photorealistic. No letters, numbers or captions. Top row left to right:1 a BLANK square BUFF frame matching the screenshot's blue status tiles, luminous cold cyan edge with a slim black-steel outer rim and empty dark-navy center;2 a BLANK square HARMFUL frame matching its red/violet root tile, crimson rim and empty dark-navy center;3 the screenshot's simple clean luminous BLUE SHIELD with ivory edge, no tile/frame;4 the screenshot's pale cyan/ivory muscular upper-body/raised-arm RESOLVE symbol, no frame. Middle row:5 the screenshot's demonic ROOT/RESTRAINT tangled claw/vines symbol, rose-purple with ivory highlights and dark contour, no frame;6 a STUN/control glyph of two pale violet stars around a broken shackle, readable tiny silhouette, no frame;7 a bright complete DIAGONAL SINGLE SWORD family emblem, ivory blade/cyan edge/dark leather grip, similar to its mastery header icon;8 a clearly HUGE BROAD GREATSWORD family emblem, one oversized ivory blade and crossguard, thick silhouette rather than another tiny sword. Bottom row:9 a DUAL SWORDS family emblem with TWO unmistakable crossed/parallel ivory blades/cyan glints, not one sword;10 an AXE family emblem, steel crescent cutting head on a brown shaft, readable bevel and real axe geometry;11 a SCYTHE family emblem, curved iron moon blade on a long slim dark shaft, strong silhouette;12 a long slim PURPLE MASTERY FILL gauge about12:1, luminous violet upper highlight, richer purple lower body, tiny white gleam along top, bevelled/chamfered complete ends. It is only a fill strip, no text or surrounding menu. Keep small-size readability: one dominant symbol each, clean negative space, rich substantial ivory/cyan highlights. The12 components are original polished game assets faithfully matching screenshot style; no fake checkerboard or background scene.

Precise production extraction from the approved screenshot reference1, NOT a redesign. Two isolated parts on genuine transparency, portrait in upper half and ribbon lower half, generous spacing. Upper: the SAME small warm-faced King inside the reference's ROUND circular silver/black-steel/cyan gem portrait. Preserve the specific dark brown pixel-cluster hair and red scarf, frontal face/expression from reference, not a new smooth anime person. The outer circular frame must be TRUE CIRCLE, equal horizontal/vertical diameter, about480px each. No attached level tag or text. Lower: the exact blank WEAPON MASTERY CHASSIS from reference, intentionally VERY SLIM: width about1200px and height about195px, STRICT6.15:1 total silhouette aspect ratio. Preserve its outer purple corner diamonds, inner navy header, one empty silver emblem lozenge on LEFT and one empty silver rank lozenge on RIGHT, blank middle header. Within the SAME outer frame below header include the long dark empty gauge well and its fine silver/ivory chamfered edges. This part is native184x30 logical; do NOT make a tall3:1 panel. All text/numbers/fill absent, no second strip, no extra third track, no icon inside header lozenge. The two assets must be complete and have no fragments/grass/background. Retain reference's crisp RPG outlines and shading, not vector placeholders or different jewel styling. Transparent background.

Production RPG ability glyph board. Reference1 is Battle of Gods' APPROVED UI look. Make SIX complete isolated skill symbols on genuine transparency, EXACTLY3 columns by2 rows with generous gutters. Do NOT imitate the tiny coarse24px grid; these are finely illustrated hard-edged game glyphs, exported72px and shown24logical pixels. Rich navy contours, luminous ivory/cyan highlights, coherent engraved/painted RPG language matching the screenshot's blue shield and mastery sword. No letters, numbers, frames, tiles, menu parts or background. TOP LEFT EARTHSPLITTER: a strong upright jagged tan/umber stone eruption,3 rock spires and a bright ivory pressure seam at its base. TOP MIDDLE MOLTEN CRASH: an explosive red/orange ground smash/flame, white-hot core, substantial bright impact silhouette and compact dark stone base. TOP RIGHT SOVEREIGN PURSUIT: a readable ivory/cyan warrior silhouette in a forward leap, bent knees, one small pale blade and a clear cold-blue landing arc beneath, distinct from running. BOTTOM LEFT UNBROKEN VOW: a bright royal/cold-blue shield with substantial ivory silver outline, a central pale diamond/spirit light, readable simple protected silhouette. BOTTOM MIDDLE WORLDSPLITTER: an epic broad violet/cyan radial ground rupture, white-hot central vertical pressure blade and several sharp upward crystal-pressure rays, compact total silhouette. BOTTOM RIGHT DODGE: an ivory/cyan RUNNING warrior, forward-leaning torso, front knee raised and trailing leg, two crisp short cold-blue speed strokes, distinct from leap. Give all six the same outline weight and material style, strong compact forms, no thin tangled strokes, no soft fog, no gold UI border, no oversized pixel mosaic. Each fully contained, clean transparent separation.
